title: ever CALLIE|Sequin Bodice Tulle High-Low Evening Dress with Ribbon Waist
descriptionHtml:
Make a sophisticated statement wearing this gorgeous high low evening dress featuring a sparkling sequin sleeveless top, ribbon cinched waist, and gorgeous layers of tulle. The asymmetrical high low hem showcases your favorite heels, pulling the look together in grace. Wear it with flats or heels to a wedding, as a bridesmaid dress, or other formal function.


Fit: Please refer to Size Chart.

Length: Knee length/High-low.


Closure: It is Concealed a Zipper Up The Back.


Undergarments: It is Padded, with Lining.


Fabric: Shell:100%Polyester, 
Lining:100%Polyester.

Stretch: Fabric is Low Stretch.
